faq.name: Is HISVIA a trading company or e-commerce platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: HISVIA is neither. We are an industrial supply chain partner that connects overseas buyers with verified Chinese manufacturing capabilities. We do not hold inventory, sell products online, or operate as a marketplace.

faq.name: How does HISVIA verify Chinese manufacturers?

acceptedAnswer.text: HISVIA uses a tiered verification process: Visual Verified (facility documentation), Document Verified (business license, certifications), Factory Verified (on-site audit), and Partner Verified (proven track record). Verification level is displayed transparently.

faq.name: Can HISVIA help with custom/OEM manufacturing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. HISVIA facilitates OEM manufacturing partnerships with IP protection measures including NDA execution before technical information sharing, contractual design protection, and buyer-owned tooling.
